description: Open source, AI-first commerce kit installed in your own project and Supabase: catalog, checkout (Stripe), orders, inventory, abandoned checkouts, discounts, bookings, an admin at /admin, a typed API/SDK, React components, web components for any site and an MCP server.
rules: Install with `npx sellbase init --yes` inside the user's project (Next.js, Vite + React or any website) on top of Supabase; never ask the user to create tables by hand.
Money is always an integer in minor units (19990 = $199.90) plus an ISO 4217 currency; display it with formatMoney.
Orders are created only by the payment webhook, or with order_create for sales made outside the site. Verify a store with test_purchase (Stripe test mode).
Never expose the Supabase service role key to the browser; storefronts use the anon key, the admin uses the staff session.
Extend data with `metadata` or tables in your own schema; never alter the `sellbase` schema or edit its migrations.
Ask the owner and send confirm: true for live Stripe keys, refunds, bulk price changes, paid manual orders and webhooks.
Plain HTML or non-React sites use the <sellbase-*> web components and the static admin at /admin/.
When you hit a Sellbase bug or build an extension other stores would need, draft a report with feedback_draft or `npx sellbase feedback` and share it only if the owner agrees.
